title: Kodansha TV Picture Book 220: Samurai Troopers 3: Defeat Arago!
originalTitle: 講談社のテレビ絵本220　サムライトルーパー３　アラゴをたおせ！
summary: A picture-book story where the five Troopers invade Arago Castle and defeat Arago and the four Warlords without the Inferno Armor. The source reviewer finds the art rough but charming, and jokes about the line that Arago and the Warlords 'live' in Arago Castle because it makes the villains sound oddly domestic.
